headline: Muted execution in 2Q; recovery expected in FY28

highlights: The resultant gain of INR2.9b was recognized as an exceptional item in the P&L.  KNRC’s execution was muted again in 2QFY27; however, its margin expanded QoQ to 9.2% in 2QFY27 from 5.5% in 1QFY27.
Management expects the performance to improve in 2HFY27, supported by the ramp-up of mining projects.
We expect revenue growth to pick up from FY28 as recently won orders enter the execution phase.
We further estimate a revenue and EBITDA CAGR of 22% and 48%, respectively, over FY26-28.
